name: Classical Strings
material: Classical, hymns and popular songs arranged for strings
alt: A violinist playing at an outdoor mountain wedding ceremony, with the couple at a flowered arch behind her.
blurb: The first notes of Canon in D begin, and every guest stands up and turns around. That's what a lot of couples are picturing when they ask for strings, and it sounds just as lovely at a cocktail hour, a gala, a long dinner or a memorial service. You can book one violinist, a duo, a trio or a full string quartet of two violins, viola and cello, and they can play music from Bach in the processional to Coldplay arranged for strings.

setlist.note: Want to see every song? Take a look at our string quartet page. If you want a song that isn't on the list, let us know and we can usually have it arranged for your group.
